text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day.
We were heading to the shrine for our first visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. I have located Teio-san
and McQueen-san.
Looking at the monitor in the electronics store that Mihono Bourbon is pointing at—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen appeared
on the 'New Year's Umamusume of the Year SP'.
It looks like a talk show discussing this year's race entries and the most talked-about Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, entering the Senior Class this year are
Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: She's been quite the hot topic among fans and racing insiders alike. Are you keeping an eye on her as well?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see. Honestly, Bourbon's been on my radar ever since she ran in the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because everyone keeps comparing themselves to me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I'm thinking of going
to watch a race live in person sometime soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, I will be racing against
the two of them in the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?
Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, what is the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of Bourbon-san and Rice-san's
reputations and abilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still, all I have to do is run my own race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. I'm rooting for you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's way too flippant, Teio-san! The way you said it was far too casual!
Their playful, lighthearted banter enlivened the studio with a cheerful atmosphere as the special program carried on.

You seem curious about what happens next,
but the sun will set if we don't hurry.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Yes, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Two bows, two claps, one bow.
Completed without a single mistake."

Mihono Bourbon approached the shrine visit with full focus.
I found myself wondering what she wished for.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's a victory in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I enter the Senior Class starting this year.
I deemed it an appropriate 'wish' for my New Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, a causal relationship between prayer and victory has not been scientifically proven, and—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Both Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio possess overwhelming talent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In order to compete evenly against them in races,
further rigorous training is absolutely essential.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Today was scheduled to be an off day, but I request permission to train.

"...Perhaps that program from earlier
inspired me a little."
choice_data_list: Let's get some proper rest today.
Boost your luck with a fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Get plenty of rest," you say?
...However...
choice_data_list: Rest is an important part of training, too.
Rest is an important part of training, too.

text_block_list.text: When I told her to get plenty of rest in preparation for the hard training starting tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Order received.
I will take a thorough rest today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To start with...
what kind of rest would you like to take?
choice_data_list: Want to go for a walk?

text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master, a kite is flying.
We were able to spend a relaxing New Year's together.

"To take on the even stronger rivals awaiting us in the future,
I want the two of us to combine our strength and give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Luck boosting through fortune slips", was it?
Order acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, Master... I cannot understand the method by which a fortune slip increases one's "luck."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...What even is 'luck' in the first place...?
After managing to persuade Mihono Bourbon, who seemed utterly bewildered, to draw a fortune slip—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's "Great Fortune."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...?

At any rate, we were able to spend
a warm and harmonious New Year together.

"To take on the even stronger rivals awaiting us in the future,
I want the two of us to combine our strength and give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Mastering a new technique," is it?
Order acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will devise, master, and execute
the running style required for the Senior Year.
Afterward, we promptly headed back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause is unknown, but—
the air today feels exceptionally "pleasant" compared to usual.

And so, I devoted myself to mastering the new technique
to my heart's content.

"To take on the even stronger rivals awaiting us in the future,
I want the two of us to combine our strength and give it our all!"
